name: IRONMAN 70.3 Oceanside

build.note: Oceanside build starts after a 2-week easy recovery block following IM California (Oct 18, 2026). Nov 13-20 vacation: no structured training.

target_splits.transitions: 0:10 combined (IM California T1+T2 was 21:22 -- drill these)

strategy.bike_target_power_note: Use FTP (221w) as the reference; set the target after the bike fit check.
strategy.run_pacing_plan: Hold back miles 1-4 (walk/run 9/1). Miles 5-10 at target pace. Miles 11-13.1 hold steady, do not chase. A walk at every aid station.

course_notes: Confirm course details from the official Oceanside course map before finalizing the bike target.
climate_notes: April in Oceanside: cool, marine-layer mornings. Plan layers for the swim start.

nutrition_plan.bike_fueling: Carry chews every 10-20 min (2 chews every 10 min at IM California) plus PF 60 and Gatorade. Target 60-80 g/hr for a 70.3 bike.
nutrition_plan.run_fueling: One fixed carb source every 20 min on the run (gel or chews), walk breaks for the intake. Aid stations as backup. Electrolytes at aid stations.

equipment_plan.bike: Quintana Roo Kilo. Complete bike fit check on cleat and footbed position before Oceanside (IM California foot pressure from ~mile 56).
equipment_plan.checklist_notes: Torque wrench and mechanical checklist one week before race.

prior_race_lessons_carried_forward: Fixed run fueling every 20 min (IM California run intake was irregular).
Drill T1 and T2 (IM California transitions 21:22).
Bike fit check for foot pressure (IM California pain from ~mile 56).
Hold the walk-run plan after mile 10.
Track pain and equipment problems as structured events.

week_focus.1: Recovery block after IM California. Easy only.
week_focus.10: Build. Holiday week, keep it steady.
week_focus.14: Peak begins. Brick and long run.
week_focus.15: Peak. Longest bike of the block.
week_focus.16: Peak. Longest run of the block.

week1_special_rule: If current_week == 1 (Oct 19-25, 2026), this week is mandatory post-IM California recovery. Low or zero TSS is intentional and correct -- never flag as concerning, behind, or at risk. Only encourage rest, recovery, hydration, and booking a bike fit.
